purpose: Translate an approved policy mandate into an authorized programme with outcomes, beneficiaries, targets and an accountable institution.
institution: Cabinet Office and Lead Ministry

steps.name: Validate legal mandate
steps.explanation: Confirm that the policy has a valid legal authority, defined jurisdiction and no unresolved legal conflict before operational design begins.
steps.requiredEvidence: Published policy, legal instrument and mandate decision

steps.name: Define outcomes and beneficiaries
steps.explanation: Describe the intended change, beneficiary cohort, baseline, indicators and service levels in terms that can be measured.
steps.requiredEvidence: Outcome framework and beneficiary definition

steps.name: Review affordability and inclusion
steps.explanation: Test affordability, duplication, equality, accessibility, environmental and data requirements before approval.
steps.requiredEvidence: Cost model, inclusion assessment and data-source review

steps.name: Approve programme gate
steps.explanation: Record the authorized programme owner, targets, reporting obligations and conditions for moving into project registration.
steps.requiredEvidence: Programme approval decision

rules.explanation: A programme involving a digital service must be reviewed against the national digital service standards.
Every funded programme must have an affordability and funding assessment before approval.

purpose: Control the procurement lifecycle from approved need through competition, evaluation, conflict checks and award recommendation.
institution: Procuring Entity and Public Procurement Authority

steps.name: Select procurement method
steps.explanation: Select an approved method using the estimated value, category, urgency and applicable thresholds.
steps.requiredEvidence: Procurement plan and method decision

steps.name: Publish tender and receive bids
steps.explanation: Publish complete specifications and preserve an auditable record of suppliers, clarifications and bid submissions.
steps.requiredEvidence: Published tender and bid register

steps.name: Evaluate and check conflicts
steps.explanation: Evaluate responsive bids, record reasons, check beneficial ownership and capture declarations of interest.
steps.requiredEvidence: Evaluation report, conflict declarations and ownership checks

steps.name: Approve award
steps.explanation: Obtain the required approval and notify affected parties before contract activation.
steps.requiredEvidence: Award recommendation and approval decision

rules.explanation: Procurement above a statutory threshold must use an approved competitive method.
Every evaluator must submit a conflict declaration before evaluation results can be accepted.

purpose: Match budget, contract, delivery evidence, invoice, approval, bank settlement and ledger reconciliation before closing a payment.
institution: Accounting Officer, Treasury and Receiving Institution

steps.name: Validate invoice
steps.explanation: Check supplier identity, contract reference, tax details, arithmetic and required invoice fields.
steps.requiredEvidence: Validated invoice and supplier record

steps.name: Complete three or four-way match
steps.explanation: Match the invoice to the contract or purchase order, accepted delivery and available budget before approval.
steps.requiredEvidence: Match result and acceptance evidence

steps.name: Approve and disburse
steps.explanation: Apply segregation of duties, approve the payment and dispatch it through the authorized treasury process.
steps.requiredEvidence: Approval decision and payment instruction

steps.name: Reconcile and close
steps.explanation: Match the bank transaction to the ledger, supplier account, project and outcome contribution, or open an exception.
steps.requiredEvidence: Bank statement, ledger entry and reconciliation result

rules.explanation: A payment must remain within an available appropriation and its lawful purpose.
The payment approver must be independent from preparation and supplier bank-account changes.

workflowName: Daily Source Health and Stale Data Escalation
schedule: Every day at 06:00 Africa/Johannesburg
escalationTrigger: Source remains stale or unavailable after health check
purpose: Check government source freshness, event processing health and reconciliation queues before the daily intelligence briefing.
institution: Government Intelligence Engine and connected source institutions

steps.name: Run source health checks
steps.explanation: Connect to each registered source and record availability, authentication, response time and last successful event.
steps.requiredEvidence: Source health result and timestamp

steps.name: Detect stale or missing data
steps.explanation: Compare the latest source event with the freshness SLA and create a data-quality signal when the source is late or silent.
steps.requiredEvidence: Freshness evaluation and source SLA

steps.name: Create remediation task
steps.explanation: Assign the source owner a remediation task with an SLA, affected dashboards and the expected recovery evidence.
steps.requiredEvidence: Assigned remediation task

steps.name: Escalate unresolved outage
steps.explanation: Escalate the outage to the institutional owner and platform leadership when the source remains stale after the first response window.
steps.requiredEvidence: Escalation record and acknowledgement

rules.explanation: Digital government sources must be monitored for availability and freshness.

escalations.action: Create remediation task and request acknowledgement
Escalate source outage and publish affected-data warning
Open incident response and include outage in executive briefing

schedule: Every 2 days at 08:00 Africa/Johannesburg
escalationTrigger: Task is overdue, blocked or has missed its service-level target
purpose: Review overdue tasks and blocked lifecycle work, notify accountable owners and escalate unresolved material delays.
institution: All participating ministries, state-owned enterprises and government agents

steps.name: Find overdue work
steps.explanation: Select open tasks whose due date or service-level clock has expired and exclude approved pauses.
steps.requiredEvidence: Overdue task query result

steps.name: Notify accountable owner
steps.explanation: Send the owner the task, evidence gap, dependency, age and expected recovery date.
steps.requiredEvidence: Notification and delivery acknowledgement

steps.name: Open or update bottleneck
steps.explanation: Create a bottleneck signal when the task is blocked by funding, capacity, legal, data or dependency constraints.
steps.requiredEvidence: Bottleneck assessment

steps.name: Escalate material delay
steps.explanation: Escalate high-materiality or repeatedly overdue work to the institution lead and executive coordination function.
steps.requiredEvidence: Escalation decision and impact assessment

rules.explanation: Delivery exceptions must remain visible and be routed for action.

escalations.action: Send reminder and request recovery date
Review capacity and dependency blockers
Escalate material delay for intervention decision

trigger: Scheduled daily run at 07:30 and BidEvaluated
schedule: Every day at 07:30 Africa/Johannesburg
escalationTrigger: High-confidence procurement red flag remains unreviewed
purpose: Review procurement signals such as split purchases, bid concentration, related parties and unsupported variations without treating a signal as a finding of guilt.
institution: Public Procurement Authority and procuring entities

steps.name: Evaluate procurement signals
steps.explanation: Run machine-readable procurement rules against new bids, awards, supplier relationships and transaction patterns.
steps.requiredEvidence: Rule execution result and source facts

steps.name: Triage red flag
steps.explanation: A human reviewer checks data quality, alternative explanations, materiality and whether the signal requires a case or correction.
steps.requiredEvidence: Triage assessment and reviewer notes

steps.name: Request evidence
steps.explanation: Request declarations, ownership records, procurement files and explanations from the responsible institution.
steps.requiredEvidence: Evidence request and response

steps.name: Escalate or close signal
steps.explanation: Escalate unresolved high-confidence signals to assurance or investigation authorities, or record a supported closure.
steps.requiredEvidence: Review decision and referral or closure record

rules.explanation: Repeated related purchases may require review for prohibited splitting or an incorrect procurement method.
Overlapping beneficial ownership requires enhanced review and documented conflict assessment.

escalations.action: Request missing evidence and record alternative explanations
Open compliance case or approve supported closure
Refer the signal with evidence and preserve chain of custody

trigger: ProjectCompleted or ContractAccepted or AssetTransferred or CapitalPaymentReconciled
escalationTrigger: Completed project has no accepted asset record after 10 business days
purpose: Create and accept a public asset record after construction, acquisition or transfer, verify its location and assign an accountable operating institution.
institution: Owning institution, accounting officer and responsible operating institution

steps.name: Receive completion or transfer event
steps.explanation: Start asset registration from an accepted project, contract, transfer or reconciled capital payment event.
steps.requiredEvidence: Completion certificate, transfer record or reconciled payment

steps.name: Validate asset facts and location
steps.explanation: Confirm the asset identity, specification, jurisdiction, GPS location, ownership and supporting evidence.
steps.requiredEvidence: GIS record, inspection evidence and technical specification

steps.name: Assign ownership and operation
steps.explanation: Record the owning institution, responsible operator, maintenance institution, service links and applicable roles.
steps.requiredEvidence: Ownership decision and operating responsibility assignment

steps.name: Approve operational acceptance
steps.explanation: Approve the asset for operational use and activate its maintenance, inspection and service performance schedule.
steps.requiredEvidence: Approved acceptance decision and asset register record

rules.explanation: An asset cannot become operational without acceptance evidence and an accountable owner.
Operational public assets must have a verifiable geographic record where location is applicable.

escalations.action: Request missing evidence and correct the asset record
Escalate unaccepted asset to the accounting officer
Open a capital asset control exception

trigger: Scheduled daily scan or InspectionCompleted or ConditionChanged or WarrantyExpiring
schedule: Every day at 05:30 Africa/Johannesburg
escalationTrigger: Maintenance due date passed or critical asset remains without an approved work order
purpose: Detect due maintenance, create funded work orders, preserve evidence and prevent asset condition or service availability from deteriorating.
institution: Owning institution, operating institution and maintenance service provider

steps.name: Detect maintenance due
steps.explanation: Identify assets approaching or passing their inspection, warranty or preventive maintenance date.
steps.requiredEvidence: Maintenance schedule and asset condition history

steps.name: Assess condition and priority
steps.explanation: Assess service criticality, safety, condition, cost and public impact to determine maintenance priority.
steps.requiredEvidence: Condition assessment and priority decision

steps.name: Approve work order and funding
steps.explanation: Confirm funding, procurement method, supplier or internal team and the approved maintenance scope.
steps.requiredEvidence: Approved work order, budget and procurement record

steps.name: Complete and verify maintenance
steps.explanation: Complete the work, capture before-and-after evidence, verify condition and set the next maintenance date.
steps.requiredEvidence: Work completion, inspection and updated asset condition

rules.explanation: Critical public services require earlier and higher-priority maintenance planning.
External maintenance must follow the applicable procurement method and threshold controls.

escalations.action: Assign work order and publish the expected completion date
Review funding, supplier and capacity constraints
Escalate material service and safety risk for intervention

trigger: Scheduled risk-based review or AuditInspectionRequested or MaterialConditionChange or RedFlagRaised
schedule: Monthly for high-risk assets; quarterly for standard assets
escalationTrigger: Inspection is overdue or evidence indicates an unsafe, missing or materially impaired asset
purpose: Independently verify asset existence, location, condition, utilisation and continued service value.
institution: Owning institution, government agent, regulator and assurance institution

steps.name: Create risk-based inspection task
steps.explanation: Select assets based on value, age, condition, service criticality, complaints and statutory inspection frequency.
steps.requiredEvidence: Inspection task, risk score and assignment

steps.name: Capture field and GIS evidence
steps.explanation: Verify location, existence, condition, utilisation and safety with photographs, measurements and geospatial evidence.
steps.requiredEvidence: Inspection report, GPS record, photographs and measurements

steps.name: Review findings and exceptions
steps.explanation: Compare field findings with the registry, financial records, project evidence and previous inspection history.
steps.requiredEvidence: Finding assessment and exception classification

steps.name: Approve condition and action
steps.explanation: Approve the condition rating and initiate maintenance, incident, investigation, impairment or registry correction action.
steps.requiredEvidence: Approved condition rating and action decision

rules.machineExpression: inspection.completed = true -> inspection.gps != null && inspection.inspector != null && inspection.evidence.count > 0
rules.explanation: An inspection requires attributable, location-aware evidence before it can be accepted.
Material impairment or a missing asset requires a controlled financial or assurance review.

escalations.action: Reassign overdue inspection and request evidence
Escalate missing, unsafe or materially impaired asset
Refer unresolved material finding with evidence chain

schedule: Annual budget preparation and quarterly review
purpose: Create a controlled budget allocation linked to a lawful mandate, programme, project and outcome.
institution: National Treasury and responsible institution

schedule: Monthly forecast versus actual review
purpose: Control changes to approved budget lines, programmes, projects and institutions.
institution: National Treasury and institutional finance office

trigger: Scheduled release calendar or AllocationApproved or ReleaseMilestoneReached
schedule: Weekly or monthly release calendar
purpose: Release approved funding after cash, reporting, bank and control conditions are validated.
institution: National Treasury and receiving institution

schedule: Daily scan for commitments without budget reservation
purpose: Prevent commitments from exceeding available budget or bypassing procurement and approval controls.
institution: Responsible institution procurement and finance offices

trigger: Scheduled exception scan or BudgetControlFailed or PaymentReconciliationFailed
schedule: Daily scan and weekly unresolved-exception escalation
purpose: Identify and resolve overspend, stale funding, unreconciled payments and unsupported expenditure.
institution: Institutional finance office, National Treasury and assurance body

schedule: Financial year closure calendar
purpose: Close allocations and control returns, accruals, commitments and approved carry-forwards.
institution: National Treasury and institutional accounting office

schedule: Daily scan for payments without complete evidence
purpose: Verify invoice, contract, delivery and acceptance evidence before payment approval.
institution: Responsible institution finance and assurance functions

schedule: Daily scan for payments without budget evidence
purpose: Verify available appropriation, lawful purpose and commitment before payment approval.
institution: National Treasury and responsible institution

schedule: Daily review of approval-role overlaps
purpose: Detect preparation, supplier-account maintenance, approval and reconciliation role conflicts.
institution: Responsible institution and assurance function

schedule: Hourly monitoring and daily overdue scan
purpose: Monitor payment instructions through bank settlement and identify overdue or failed settlement events.
institution: Treasury, banking interface and responsible institution

trigger: Daily exception scan or BudgetControlFailed or PaymentHeld or PaymentRejected
schedule: Daily scan and weekly unresolved-exception escalation
purpose: Classify, assign, escalate and close payment control exceptions with an evidence trail.
institution: Institutional finance, Treasury and assurance body

schedule: Daily duplicate-pattern scan
purpose: Review duplicate, split, unusual or unsupported payment signals before execution or close-out.
institution: Responsible institution internal audit and finance control

schedule: Weekly recovery ageing review
purpose: Monitor recovery, reversal, notification, accounting and evidence requirements for an irregular payment.
institution: Responsible institution, Treasury and legal or assurance function

schedule: Monthly close-out completeness scan
escalationTrigger: Close-out evidence, outcome linkage or retention package remains incomplete after the control SLA
escalationOwner: Institutional Finance Director and Records Assurance Lead
purpose: Confirm reconciliation, evidence retention, outcome linkage and final payment oversight conclusion without changing the source payment record.
institution: Responsible institution finance, National Treasury and records assurance functions

steps.name: Confirm payment reconciliation
steps.explanation: Verify that the payment, ledger, bank settlement and supplier references agree and that any variance is resolved or formally classified.
steps.requiredEvidence: Payment record, ledger entry, bank settlement and reconciliation statement

steps.name: Validate final evidence package
steps.explanation: Confirm that invoice, contract, procurement, delivery, acceptance and approval evidence is indexed and attributable.
steps.requiredEvidence: Indexed payment evidence package and acceptance reference

steps.name: Link payment to outcome
steps.explanation: Connect the payment to its programme, project, milestone and intended public outcome for traceability.
steps.requiredEvidence: Programme, project, milestone and outcome references

steps.name: Apply retention classification
steps.explanation: Assign the approved records-retention class, preserve the immutable evidence index and record the retention owner and review date.
steps.requiredEvidence: Retention classification, evidence index and custody record

steps.name: Issue close-out conclusion
steps.explanation: Record a passed, exception or escalated oversight conclusion and route unresolved findings to the accountable authority.
steps.requiredEvidence: Close-out conclusion, exceptions and approval decision

rules.explanation: A payment cannot be closed out without attributable reconciliation evidence.
A reconciled payment must remain traceable to the approved programme and project outcome.
The close-out package must be indexed and assigned an approved retention class before completion.
Every close-out exception requires an accountable owner and an escalation route.

escalations.action: Request missing reconciliation, evidence or retention metadata and set a due date
Review unresolved close-out exception and approve a corrective action
Escalate material unresolved payment close-out finding with the evidence chain

workflowName: Water Catchment Licensing and Service Resilience
trigger: WaterPermitApplicationReceived or CatchmentLevelChanged or WaterQualityAlertRaised or ServiceOutageReported
schedule: Daily catchment and service-risk scan
escalationTrigger: Permit, water-quality or service-resilience exception remains unresolved beyond the response SLA
escalationOwner: National Water Management Authority Director and Environmental Regulator
purpose: Monitor lawful water-resource decisions, catchment condition, water quality, service resilience and evidence of corrective action.
institution: National Water Management Authority, responsible water utilities, local authorities and environmental regulator
ownerRole: Catchment Compliance and Service Resilience Officer

steps.name: Register water signal
steps.explanation: Register the permit, catchment, quality or outage signal with location, source and affected service context.
steps.requiredEvidence: Source event, location and affected catchment or service record

steps.name: Assess lawful and environmental impact
steps.explanation: Assess permit status, environmental conditions, downstream users, water quality and service impact.
steps.requiredEvidence: Permit, environmental assessment, monitoring result and impact assessment

steps.name: Assign corrective intervention
steps.explanation: Assign the responsible institution and corrective action, including public-service continuity measures where required.
steps.requiredEvidence: Approved intervention, accountable owner and target date

steps.name: Verify resolution and report
steps.explanation: Verify evidence of resolution, update the catchment or service record and report unresolved material risks.
steps.requiredEvidence: Verification report, monitoring result and closure decision

rules.explanation: Material water-resource activities require an approved environmental assessment before implementation.
A below-standard water-quality result requires a corrective intervention and escalation route.
Publicly funded corrective interventions must remain linked to an approved budget and evidence.

escalations.action: Validate the water signal and assign the responsible institution
Approve corrective action and service continuity response
Escalate material environmental or public-service risk

workflowName: Forest Management, Permit and Restoration Oversight
trigger: ForestPermitIssued or HarvestActivityReported or DeforestationAlertRaised or RestorationMilestoneDue
schedule: Weekly satellite, permit and restoration-monitoring scan
escalationTrigger: Unauthorised clearing, permit non-conformance or restoration milestone remains unresolved
escalationOwner: Forestry Department Director and Environmental Regulator
purpose: Monitor forest permits, lawful harvesting, geospatial evidence, community safeguards, restoration commitments and environmental outcomes.
institution: Forestry Department, local authorities, traditional authorities, environmental regulator and assurance institutions

steps.name: Match activity to permit
steps.explanation: Match the reported forest activity to the permit holder, approved area, activity type and validity period.
steps.requiredEvidence: Permit, GIS boundary, activity report and operator identity

steps.name: Verify geospatial and community evidence
steps.explanation: Verify satellite or field evidence, protected-area overlap, community consultation and reported area change.
steps.requiredEvidence: GIS evidence, field report, consultation record and imagery reference

steps.name: Assess restoration obligation
steps.explanation: Determine restoration, rehabilitation, offset or enforcement obligations and assign measurable milestones.
steps.requiredEvidence: Restoration plan, baseline, target and accountable institution

steps.name: Close or escalate finding
steps.explanation: Close the finding when evidence meets the obligation or refer unresolved non-compliance for enforcement and assurance review.
steps.requiredEvidence: Closure evidence, enforcement referral or approved exception

rules.explanation: Reported forest activity must occur within an active approved permit boundary.
Material forest impacts require an approved restoration plan supported by baseline evidence.
A closed forest finding must retain geospatial provenance and an attributable decision-maker.

escalations.action: Request permit, boundary or field evidence and assign a verification task
Suspend close-out and determine restoration or enforcement action
Refer material unresolved forest non-compliance with the GIS evidence chain

workflowName: Carbon Credit Project, MRV and Issuance Integrity
trigger: CarbonProjectRegistered or MonitoringReportSubmitted or VerificationCompleted or CreditIssuanceRequested or ReversalRiskRaised
schedule: Monthly monitoring, reporting and verification completeness scan
escalationTrigger: Monitoring, verification, additionality, permanence or double-counting exception remains unresolved
escalationOwner: National Carbon Registry Authority and Environmental Regulator
purpose: Monitor carbon-credit project registration, measurement-reporting-verification evidence, additionality, permanence, registry integrity and public-benefit claims.
institution: National Carbon Registry Authority, project developer, independent verifier, local communities and environmental regulator

steps.name: Register carbon project
steps.explanation: Register the project boundary, methodology, developer, tenure, safeguards and baseline before monitoring begins.
steps.requiredEvidence: Project design document, GIS boundary, tenure and safeguards record

steps.name: Review monitoring report
steps.explanation: Review measured activity data, baseline assumptions, leakage, permanence risks and community-benefit evidence.
steps.requiredEvidence: Monitoring report, calculation workbook, source measurements and safeguards evidence

steps.name: Confirm independent verification
steps.explanation: Confirm that an authorised independent verifier reviewed the report and resolved material findings.
steps.requiredEvidence: Verification statement, findings log and verifier accreditation

steps.name: Check registry integrity
steps.explanation: Check ownership, retirement status, double counting, issuance volume and linkage to the verified monitoring period.
steps.requiredEvidence: Registry audit, serial-number range and ownership declaration

steps.name: Issue or hold credits
steps.explanation: Record an oversight conclusion to approve the registry workflow, hold issuance or escalate an integrity exception.
steps.requiredEvidence: Issuance decision, exception record and audit trail

rules.explanation: A registered carbon project requires a defined boundary and approved environmental safeguards.
Credits cannot proceed to issuance without accepted independent verification.

rules.machineExpression: carbon.issuance.requested = true -> carbon.registry.serialRange.overlap = false && carbon.claimedElsewhere = false
rules.explanation: Registry issuance requires serial-number uniqueness and a declaration that the reduction is not claimed elsewhere.
Publicly funded carbon projects require traceability from funding to reported public benefits.

escalations.action: Request missing monitoring, safeguard or registry evidence
Place issuance request on hold and require independent review
Escalate material integrity, reversal or double-counting risk for formal decision

workflowName: Zambia Integrated Land Management and Parcel Integrity
trigger: ParcelCreated or BoundaryChanged or LandUseChanged or DisputeRegistered or OfficialSearchRequested
schedule: Daily duplicate-interest and stale-record scan; quarterly parcel integrity review
escalationTrigger: Parcel conflict, duplicate interest, missing survey evidence or unresolved land dispute exceeds its service-level target
escalationOwner: Permanent Secretary — Lands and Natural Resources and Registrar of Lands
purpose: Maintain an authoritative, geospatially verified, non-duplicative land record before allocation, transfer or title-deed issuance.
institution: Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources, Lands and Deeds Registry, Survey Department, planning authorities, local authorities and traditional authorities
participants: Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources
approvalAuthorities: Relevant traditional authority where customary land is involved

steps.name: Create or reconcile parcel identity
steps.explanation: Assign a unique parcel identifier and reconcile coordinates, survey plan, tenure category, area and existing interests.
steps.requiredEvidence: Unique parcel ID, survey plan, coordinates and parcel history

steps.name: Run official search and conflict checks
steps.explanation: Search registered interests, pending applications, cautions, disputes, duplicate identifiers, overlaps and restricted land layers.
steps.requiredEvidence: Official search, conflict report, cadastral overlap report and dispute check

steps.name: Verify planning and environmental compatibility
steps.explanation: Confirm zoning, planning permission, protected areas, environmental restrictions, infrastructure reservations and public-purpose constraints.
steps.requiredEvidence: Planning opinion, zoning extract, environmental clearance or exemption and restriction map

steps.name: Confirm lawful holder and consent chain
steps.explanation: Confirm the lawful current holder, applicant identity, beneficial interest, required consents and absence of unresolved competing claims.
steps.requiredEvidence: Identity, consent chain, authority resolution, claim review and conflict declaration

steps.name: Approve registry update
steps.explanation: Approve the parcel or land-interest update only after all mandatory checks pass and preserve the immutable decision record.
steps.requiredEvidence: Approval decision, signed checklist and audit correlation ID

rules.sourceInstrumentName: Zambia Lands and Deeds Registry Act
rules.explanation: A proposed land interest must not duplicate an existing interest or overlap an incompatible registered parcel.

rules.sourceInstrumentName: Zambia Lands and Deeds Registry Act
rules.explanation: Approval must rely on a recent official search rather than a stale registry snapshot.

rules.sourceInstrumentName: Zambia Urban and Regional Planning Act
rules.machineExpression: land.use.proposed != null -> planning.zoningCompatible = true && planning.approvalRequired = false || planning.approval.status = 'Approved'
rules.explanation: Proposed use must be compatible with planning controls or have the required planning approval.
A land decision must not be approved while a competing claim or active caution remains unresolved.

escalations.action: Place the transaction on hold and request missing search, survey or consent evidence
Convene registry, survey, planning and authority review of the conflict

escalations.recipientRole: Registrar of Lands and Permanent Secretary — Lands
escalations.action: Issue a controlled decision, dispute referral or investigation referral; prohibit duplicate allocation

workflowName: Zambia Customary Land Consent, Conversion and Acquisition
trigger: CustomaryLandApplicationReceived or TraditionalAuthorityConsentSubmitted or ConversionRequested or CustomaryClaimDisputed
schedule: Weekly customary-land application and consent-chain review
escalationTrigger: Traditional consent, community consultation, compensation, resettlement, boundary or competing-claim issue remains unresolved
escalationOwner: Commissioner of Lands and relevant Provincial Administration
purpose: Ensure customary land acquisition or conversion is voluntary, documented, consultative, geospatially clear and not allocated to competing people.
institution: Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources, traditional authority, local authority, district planning authority, community representatives, Survey Department, applicant, affected holders and environmental regulator
participants: Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources

steps.name: Register customary land application
steps.explanation: Register the applicant, proposed use, affected area, traditional authority, community and preliminary parcel geometry without creating an allocation.
steps.requiredEvidence: Application, identity, proposed use, preliminary GIS boundary and affected-holder list

steps.name: Confirm customary holder and community consultation
steps.explanation: Confirm the existing customary holder or holders and document transparent consultation, objections, vulnerable-group participation and community resolution.
steps.requiredEvidence: Customary-holder confirmation, meeting notices, attendance, minutes, objections and resolution

steps.name: Survey and duplicate-allocation search
steps.explanation: Complete the survey and search customary, cadastral, registry, planning and dispute records to prevent an overlapping or second allocation.
steps.requiredEvidence: Approved survey plan, unique parcel ID, overlap report and official search

steps.name: Assess compensation, resettlement and safeguards
steps.explanation: Assess compensation, livelihood impact, resettlement, environmental impact and public-interest conditions before approval.
steps.requiredEvidence: Valuation, compensation agreement, resettlement plan and environmental decision

steps.name: Approve conversion or acquisition
steps.explanation: Record the traditional consent and statutory approval chain; do not issue a title or conversion decision while any objection or claim is unresolved.
steps.requiredEvidence: Traditional consent, statutory approval, objection resolution and signed decision

steps.name: Register resulting interest
steps.explanation: Register the approved interest with a unique parcel and title reference only after the registry re-check confirms no intervening allocation.
steps.requiredEvidence: Final survey, approval decision, registry re-check and registration record

rules.explanation: Customary conversion requires verified holder information and recorded traditional-authority consent.
Approval must not proceed while community objections or competing claims remain open.

rules.sourceInstrumentName: Zambia Lands and Deeds Registry Act
rules.explanation: The registry must confirm one unique parcel interest and no competing application for the same applicant and parcel.
Material land-use impacts require an environmental decision before conversion or acquisition approval.

escalations.action: Suspend processing and request missing consent, consultation, survey or claim evidence

escalations.recipientRole: Provincial Lands Officer and Traditional Authority
escalations.action: Convene a documented community, survey and dispute-resolution review
Reject, refer or approve with recorded safeguards; block any duplicate allocation or title request

workflowName: Zambia State Land Allocation, Lease and Title-Deed Issuance
trigger: StateLandApplicationReceived or AllocationApprovalRequested or LeaseExecuted or TitleDeedRequested or TransferRequested
schedule: Daily state-land allocation, lease and title-deed control scan
escalationTrigger: Duplicate interest, incomplete approval, unpaid required charges, missing survey, title conflict or unauthorised transfer is detected
escalationOwner: Commissioner of Lands and Registrar of Lands
purpose: Control state-land allocation and title-deed issuance through transparent approval, verified survey, official search, planning compliance and non-duplication checks.
institution: Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources, Commissioner of Lands, Lands and Deeds Registry, Survey Department, local planning authority, valuation office, applicant, conveyancer, environmental regulator and public-accountability bodies
ownerRole: State Land Allocation and Registration Officer
participants: Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources

steps.name: Register and screen application
steps.explanation: Register the applicant, intended use, eligibility, beneficial ownership, parcel request and conflict declarations without reserving land prematurely.
steps.requiredEvidence: Application, identity, beneficial ownership declaration, proposed use and conflict declaration

steps.name: Confirm state-land availability
steps.explanation: Confirm the parcel is state land available for allocation and is not committed, occupied, reserved, disputed, protected or already allocated.
steps.requiredEvidence: State-land inventory extract, GIS availability check, occupation check and reservation check

steps.name: Complete valuation, planning and environmental checks
steps.explanation: Obtain valuation, planning compatibility, zoning, development conditions and environmental decisions before allocation approval.
steps.requiredEvidence: Valuation, planning approval or opinion, zoning extract and environmental decision

steps.name: Approve allocation and execute lease
steps.explanation: Record committee and Commissioner approvals, notify affected parties where required and execute the lease or allocation instrument.
steps.requiredEvidence: Committee minutes, approval instrument, notification record, lease and payment evidence

steps.name: Recheck registry before title issuance
steps.explanation: Perform a final official search and uniqueness check immediately before registration to detect intervening allocation, transfer, caution or duplicate title risk.
steps.requiredEvidence: Current official search, duplicate-title check, cadastral validation and caution clearance

steps.name: Register and issue title deed
steps.explanation: Register the interest, generate one unique title reference, apply secure issuance controls and publish the audit record without creating a second title for the same parcel.
steps.requiredEvidence: Registered instrument, unique title number, title-deed issue record and audit correlation ID

rules.machineExpression: stateLand.allocation.requested = true -> stateLand.available = true && stateLand.reserved = false && stateLand.occupied = false
rules.explanation: State land must be confirmed available before it can be allocated.

rules.sourceInstrumentName: Zambia Lands and Deeds Registry Act
rules.machineExpression: title.issue.requested = true -> registry.sameParcel.activeTitles = 0 && registry.sameParcel.pendingTitles = 0 && registry.titleNumber.unique = true
rules.explanation: A title deed may not be issued where another active or pending title exists for the same parcel.

rules.sourceInstrumentName: Zambia Lands and Deeds Registry Act
rules.machineExpression: title.issue.requested = true -> officialSearch.completed = true && officialSearch.ageDays <= 7 && officialSearch.cautionCount = 0
rules.explanation: Title issuance requires a fresh final search and no unresolved caution.

rules.sourceInstrumentName: Zambia Urban and Regional Planning Act
rules.explanation: State land lease and development use must comply with planning controls.

rules.ruleName: Public land value and payment evidence
rules.explanation: Public land allocation must preserve valuation approval and evidence of required payments or authorised arrangements.

escalations.action: Place allocation or title request on hold and request missing approval or registry evidence
Open a duplicate-interest or title-conflict review and freeze issuance

escalations.recipientRole: Commissioner of Lands and Permanent Secretary — Lands
escalations.action: Refer material conflict, suspected fraud or unauthorised allocation for formal investigation and decision
